Read input: mg_04096_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_04096(clk,reset_,raw,debounced);
input clk; 
  input reset_; 
  input raw; 
  output debounced; 
  reg [7:0] counter; 
  reg debounced; 
  reg sampled; 
  always@ (posedge clk or negedge reset_) 
  if (!reset_) 
  sampled <= 1'b0; 
  else 
  sampled <= raw; 
  always@ (posedge clk or negedge reset_) 
  if (!reset_) 
  counter <= 8'd0; 
  else if (raw != sampled) 
  counter <= 8'd0; 
  else 
  counter <= counter + 8'd1; 
  always@ (posedge clk or negedge reset_) 
  if (!reset_) 
  debounced <= 1'b0; 
  else if (counter == 8'hff) 
  debounced <= sampled; 
 endmodule
